subject: [PATCH v1 1/3] mm: memcontrol: factor reclaim logic out of try_charge_memcg()

2026-10-03.patch_summary: This patch refactors the reclaim logic from try_charge_memcg() into two new helper functions: memcg_charge_may_reclaim() and memcg_charge_reclaim(). The former checks if a memory charge is allowed, while the latter performs the actual reclamation. This separation allows for easier reuse of the reclaim logic in subsequent patches.
